items.stance: 115 of its 122 legislators voted for, and none against,

items.text: Published an alternative budget proposing to end non-contributory benefits for foreigners who have not worked full-time for at least five years.

Its leaders presented a plan to lower the retirement age to between 60 and 62, while cutting a pension by 5 percent for each missing quarter of contributions, up to half of it, reducing the pension rights earned while out of work, and adding a second, mandatory pension built from savings for workers aged 52 or under.
